CODE: NON Absence, engineered.

Founder business cards · NFC CR80 · 85.6 × 54 mm. Twenty-two executions of one idea: a company named after nothing, designed with nothing as the material. Every design is a pair, Null (founder) and Void (co-founder). Tap the card to save the contact, or scan the QR.

founder name:

01Specimen

A type-specimen sheet for a single glyph, a hand-drawn Didone O, annotated like a foundry proof. On Null's card an oxblood stroke turns it into ∅, the empty set. On Void's it becomes a counter holding one point of infinite mass. The back sets the contact details as a specimen table.
